title: Entergy Arkansas Wins MarCom Gold Award for This Is Home Magazine
summary: Entergy Arkansas has been named a 2026 MarCom Gold Award winner for This Is Home – Issue One, our Energy Efficiency magazine.
body_markdown:
Entergy Arkansas has been named a 2026 MarCom Gold Award winner for *This Is Home – Issue One* , our Energy Efficiency magazine.


The **MarCom Awards** are an international competition recognizing excellence in marketing and communications, honoring outstanding creativity, innovation, and achievement among professionals worldwide. With approximately **6,000 entries submitted annually from around the world** , this recognition is an exciting accomplishment for our team.


*This Is Home* represents more than a publication, it reflects our commitment to making energy efficiency information accessible, relevant, and actionable for the customers we serve. By sharing practical energy-saving tips through thoughtful storytelling, we’re helping households better understand how energy efficiency contributes to affordability, comfort, and long-term energy savings.


Since launching this initiative in 2025, we’ve distributed **175,000 printed copies** , including targeted outreach to some of our most vulnerable customers. You can view the magazine online at[ar.thisishomemag.com](https://ar.thisishomemag.com/) .


Congratulations to everyone who contributed to this achievement!
